description: This file provides utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing them in a linked list, with helper methods to validate tokens before adding.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a linked list of the tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the linked list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether the token is non-empty.
